services.name: Salt Shaker Charters
services.desc: Ready to experience the thrill of Cape Cod sport fishing? Book a trip with Salt Shaker Sportfishing today and prepare for an unforgettable adventure on the water! Following Coast Guard regulations, charter groups are limited to six (6) passengers plus the crew. That includes all passengers whether they are fishing or not. After the Captain confirms your trip, a 10% deposit may be requested to guarantee your booking. The remaining balance is payable to the Captain on your trip date. We accept the following payment methods: cash (USD), VISA, MasterCard, and AMEX. You may cancel or modify your booking without charge up to 7 days before your trip.
